payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for obtaining psychological dimensions of people through language analysis in social media.

claims.text: Psychological dimensions can be obtained by analyzing the vocabulary used in social media, particularly blogs, which reflect personality and motivations.
Maps can be generated from word categories that reflect psycholinguistic properties, allowing for the visualization of psychological dimensions across different demographics.
The Meaning Extraction Method (MEM) can be used to identify themes related to personal values, which are indicative of psychological dimensions.
